question: _______ permits non-government entities (NGES) to offer national and international space-based communication services.

options.text: The Internet Governance and Regulation Act, 2019

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Indian Space Policy-2023**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Space Policy 2023 states that the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) will focus on research and development of space technologies.
 
• This includes developing new launch vehicles, satellites, and other space-based systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ISRO is India's national space agency. It was founded in 1969 and has since played a leading role in developing India's space capabilities.
 
• ISRO has launched over 100 satellites and developed a number of launch vehicles, including the Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) and the Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV).
 
• ISRO is also involved in a number of research projects, including the development of a reusable launch vehicle, a human spaceflight program, and a lunar exploration programe.
